title: Where's my parcel?
hints: Switch on `status.kind`. Inside each `case`, TypeScript knows which shape you have, so `status.carrier` or `status.signedBy` is available without casts.

`assertNever` takes a parameter of type `never`, returns `never`, and its body only throws. Call it in the `default` of your switch: `default: return assertNever(status);`. Do the same in `isFinal` instead of returning `false` for everything else.

function assertNever(value: never): never { throw new Error(`Unexpected value: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`); } — and in trackingLine: case "delivered": return status.signedBy === null ? "Delivered" : `Delivered, signed by ${status.signedBy}`;
